description: Create a command palette enhancement (extend existing search modal) with quick actions, recent pages, and smart suggestions. Add a 'Getting Started' onboarding checklist for new users.
steps: Enhance src/features/search/components/search-modal.tsx: Add a 'Quick Actions' section when the query is empty (before recent searches). Quick actions include: Start Practice Session (-> /questions), Review Due Items (-> /review), View Flashcards (-> /flashcards), Open Mistakes (-> /mistakes), Check Progress (-> /insights). Show recently visited pages (store last 5 page visits in localStorage). Add action type indicators (icons for navigate, action, search).

Create src/shared/lib/page-visit-tracker.ts - a utility that tracks page visits in localStorage. Functions: recordPageVisit(path, title), getRecentPages(): Array<{path, title, timestamp}>. Cap at 10 entries. Called from the layout or a client hook.

Create src/shared/hooks/use-page-tracking.ts - a client hook that calls recordPageVisit on route changes using usePathname(). Map known paths to human-readable titles (e.g., '/questions' -> 'Question Bank', '/dashboard' -> 'Dashboard').

Create src/shared/components/ui/onboarding-checklist.tsx - a 'Getting Started' card shown on the dashboard when user has completed fewer than 3 of the checklist items. Checklist items: (1) Set up your profile, (2) Start your first practice session, (3) Review your results, (4) Create flashcards, (5) Set your exam date. Each item checks localStorage state to determine completion. Dismissible with a 'Skip' button that hides it permanently.

Update src/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-content.tsx: Add the OnboardingChecklist component after the Hero Section, shown conditionally when the user has few completed sessions. Also integrate the page tracking hook.

Update src/app/(protected)/layout.tsx to include the usePageTracking hook via a small client wrapper component (since layout is a server component, wrap the hook in a client component that renders nothing visible).
acceptance_criteria: Command palette (Cmd+K) shows Quick Actions when query is empty
Recently visited pages appear in the command palette below quick actions
Page visits are tracked in localStorage as user navigates
Onboarding checklist shows for new users (< 3 items completed) on dashboard
Checklist items auto-complete based on real state (profile set, sessions done, etc.)
